effect.name: GM Faceted Glass Studio
effect.desc: Procedural multi-facet optical glass with cell bevels, randomized normals and spectral splitting.
effect.shader: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7))+seed)*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));float c=cos(rotation),s=sin(rotation);vec2 p=mat2(c,-s,s,c)*(uv-.5)*facets;vec2 cell=floor(p),f=fract(p)-.5;float rnd=h(cell),a=rnd*6.2831853;vec2 normal=normalize(vec2(cos(a),sin(a))+f*1.4);float edge=min(.5-abs(f.x),.5-abs(f.y));float bevelMask=1.0-smoothstep(0.0,bevel,edge);vec2 off=normal*refractionPx/sz*(.35+.65*bevelMask);vec2 chroma=normal*dispersionPx/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),mid=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+off,0.0,1.0));vec3 rgb=vec3(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+off+chroma,0.0,1.0)).r,mid.g,texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+off-chroma,0.0,1.0)).b)+bevelMask*highlight;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,rgb,mixAmount),mix(src.a,mid.a,mixAmount));}
